ev.q: Of 261 patient-contacts, 173 (66%) received TSTs, and 39 (23%) had a positive reaction.
56 staff members tested positive, of whom 21 (38%) were direct-care providers
495 (63%) of 784 staff members were evaluated with TSTs
The team conducted a contact and case-finding investigation by reviewing hospital and health department records

methods_quotes.q: Among staff contacts, a positive TST was defined as induration of > 5 mm during the investigation
